title: React kit: Pair with a Code, enter a code
summary: The device that enters the code: the 8-digit field in the shown code's face with what each of you shares (pressing Pair agrees), Pairing… with an enabled Cancel, a wrong code that keeps the first two digits and waits for a different code, Too many tries that asks for a new code with the field still open, the same first two digits refused, can't find the other device, and the other answers. The phone frames moved to sdk.swiftui-pair-scan.
compare: 1: one field labelled 'Code' in the shown code's face and size (the kit's code token, 72px tall), digits only, grouped as typed ('4812 3456'); spaces and hyphens in a paste are dropped. Pair is enabled; with fewer than 8 digits it answers 'A code is 8 digits.' under the field and sends nothing. Enter submits. The shared categories come before Pair, so pressing Pair is this person's consent (V5 §15.12); there is no second 'Pair with …?' here. 'Show a code instead' (a quiet link) opens sdk.react-pair-show 2 for two people who both chose Enter.
Focus on arrival: the field on a fine pointer; the heading on a coarse pointer (UI-KITS focus rule), so a touch screen's keyboard does not cover the categories.

2: Pair keeps its label with the 16px ring and keeps focus (aria-disabled, never disabled); the field and the categories lock; Back becomes Cancel and stays enabled, and Escape does the same (R8). It looks for the other device for at most 15 seconds and dials at most two; it never retries a code by itself.

3: a wrong code tints and borders the field (never the product accent) with 'That code didn't work. Enter the code the other device shows now.' and the quiet hint '1 try left' (R6 reason wrong, R7). The first two digits stay (an answer proves them right), the other six clear, the caret sits after '48'. Pair is aria-disabled until the field holds 8 digits that differ from the code that failed; ui-core's LocalPairingModel owns this stale-code guard, so every kit gets it.

4: after two failed dials for the same first two digits in 5 minutes, a neutral notice 'Too many tries' / 'Ask for a new code on the other device.' with no countdown; the field is cleared and stays editable, and Pair is enabled as soon as the first two digits differ from the spent ones (R7). The budget itself is untouched.

4b: typing the spent first two digits again answers under the field 'Ask for a new code. This one can't be tried again yet.' (R6 reason spent; nothing is sent) and Pair stays aria-disabled. The other device's Show a new code always starts with other first two digits (R16).

5: 'Can't find the other device' / 'Check the code, and that you're both on the same network.' after 15 seconds with nothing found, or when every attempt ended before the code was checked (a mistyped first two digits, a code no longer on screen, or an app older than v0.11 look the same). Pair tries again and spends no try.

6: Not a code ('A code is 8 digits.', nothing sent), network blocked (core nearby-permission-denied, Open Settings where the platform can deep-link), pairing off (core 'Pairing unavailable', sdk.react-pair-off 3). No room is answered on Pair with a Code (sdk.react-pair-show 1b) before this screen opens.
Errors are announced (role alert) and focus stays in the field; notices are role status. Escape is Back, or Cancel while busy.
Type: five sizes, code 40, title, body 15, label 14, meta 13; the 12px category pills are the kit's (raising them to 13 is a kit-wide decision, flagged to the kit owner). Weights 400, 500, 600.
Four sizes: three windows a row at wide and desktop, two at tablet, one on phone; the answers card spans the board.
Accent, type and radii match sdk.react-activate: Polaris look by default, DJDL's coral accent, no Polaris Key or Polaris Locker words or marks anywhere (there is no account in this flow).
Words are the copyKeys below, verbatim ('revised' marks a key this round added or changed; 'was' is the old value); no 'CPace', 'nameplate', 'mode', 'link secret' or 'local link' reaches a person.

sdkNeeds.need: Joiner: pairing-code-failed carries a reason detail: wrong (the other device answered and changed its code), spent (this code's first two digits have no dial left; nothing was sent), invalid, or other-app.
Joiner: dialsLeft(text) returns 0 | 1 | 2, or null until two digits are typed (D5).
Joiner: a public cancel, join({ signal }) with an AbortSignal, or a handle.

platforms.react: Electron over Node: show, enter and manage; no scanning. In a browser or a desktop-bridge page there is no local network (connect-unavailable), so the kit renders nothing and the host shows no entry.
platforms.swiftui: iOS and iPadOS: scan first, then show, enter and manage (sdk.swiftui-pair-scan: AVFoundation, the kit's own viewfinder); the app declares NSCameraUsageDescription and the Local Network keys. macOS: show, enter and manage, no scanning, as the React boards.
platforms.compose: Android: scan first, then show, enter and manage. The Play flavour opens Google's code scanner (its own UI, no camera permission), so sdk.swiftui-pair-scan 2, 3 and 3c are iOS only; because Google's scanner cannot show the categories, its choose screen (1) shows 'Each of you shares' and the pills under Scan a code before the scanner opens. A build without Play services has no Scan a code and types the code. Desktop: show, enter and manage.
platforms.godot: Show (QR from ui/qr/), enter and manage; no scanning. Two panes by its own two_pane_fits() rule.

designReview.verdict: Fix (mediocre): after a wrong code Pair stayed live on a code that could no longer work, and after Too many tries the screen offered a wait that could never succeed and locked the field the escape needed. Fixed in one follow-up, every recommendation taken.

findings.issue: Wrong code: the failed code stayed in the field, selected, with Pair enabled, so one more Enter spent the last dial on a code certain to fail.
findings.resolution: The first two digits stay, the other six clear, the caret after '48'. Pair is aria-disabled until 8 digits that differ from the failed code (a ui-core stale-code guard). Copy 'That code didn't work. Enter the code the other device shows now.' with '1 try left'.

findings.issue: Too many tries: 'Try again in 4:51' could never succeed, and the field and Pair were locked, so the new code could not be typed.
findings.resolution: No countdown: 'Too many tries' / 'Ask for a new code on the other device.' The field is cleared and editable; Pair turns on once the first two digits differ from the spent ones. Typing the spent ones again: 'Ask for a new code. This one can't be tried again yet.' (4b).

findings.issue: Pairing… locked Back and disabled Pair for up to 45 seconds and dropped focus.
findings.resolution: Back becomes an enabled Cancel (Escape too, R8); Pair keeps its label with the 16px ring and keeps focus (aria-disabled).

findings.issue: 'Can't find the other device' blamed only the network.
findings.resolution: 'Check the code, and that you're both on the same network.' The core pairing-not-found message should match (coreCopyChanges, CC-29.0).

findings.issue: Two people who both chose Enter a code were stuck.
findings.resolution: 'Show a code instead' on this screen; 'Enter a code instead' on the show screen.

findings.issue: The phone frames made typing primary and scanning the fallback, with 22px link targets.
findings.resolution: Moved to sdk.swiftui-pair-scan: Scan a code first, typing as the fallback, 44pt links.
The field takes the shown code's size (40/48). The 12px pills are the kit's; raising them to 13 is flagged to the kit owner.
A busy button keeps its label.
Field focus on a fine pointer, the heading on a coarse one; Escape is Back, or Cancel while busy.

findings.issue: A disabled Pair at 7 digits gave no reason.
findings.resolution: Pair stays enabled and answers 'A code is 8 digits.' (the stale-code guard of 3 is the one aria-disabled case).
Open Settings where the platform can deep-link.

findings.issue: Core copy said 'Check it and try again' after a changed code.
findings.resolution: Recorded as coreCopyChanges for CC-29.0 (copy.en.json, then pnpm gen constants and the locale files); this package changes the kit's keys only.
